question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Glich" **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Glich" correct spelling is Glitch which means malfunction or fault.

 
 
• Example: The minor glitch in the program became a huge issue.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• In the question, it has been asked about the incorrect spelling given in the options
 
• **Glove** has its correct spelling which signifies the protection of the hand from dirt, during the winter season or by the players.
 
 
• **Example:** During the pandemic, gloves saved the life of Doctors who saved us.
 
 
 
• **Glade** has the correct spelling which means forest or grasslands, a beam of light(in old English).
 
 
• **Example: **Spotted a glade in the forest.
 
 
 
• **Gleam** also has the correct spelling which means shine brightly with reflected rays.
 
 
• **Example:** Moons gleam because of the Sun.
